is_anopheles.evidence: The study uses Anopheles gambiae laboratory strains (G3 and Akdr).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper mentions the L1014F mutation is present in the Akdr strain (page 1, 2), but it does not report new genotyping data for this marker in the study; it merely states the strain is known to carry it.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype counts or frequencies are reported for any mosquito populations.

african_field_population.evidence: The study uses laboratory-maintained colonies (G3 and Akdr) obtained from the Malaria Research and Reference Reagent Resource Center (MR4).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study characterizing insecticide resistance in laboratory strains.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study uses laboratory colonies, not field-collected samples.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study uses laboratory colonies, not field-collected samples.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study uses standard laboratory strains (G3 and Akdr) from a repository (MR4).

supplement.evidence: No genotype data is reported in the paper or needed.

assessment.summary: This study characterizes the toxicity of permethrin and etofenprox against two laboratory strains of Anopheles gambiae (G3 and Akdr). It does not report any new field-collected mosquito data or genotype frequencies.
exclusion_reasons: No field-collected mosquitoes (only laboratory strains used).
Does not report extractable genotype data.
